reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithWeekendRule and reuses recurConfigToRSchedule/RSchedule for the new handler, but the daily-skip rule is not made reusable and is re-written in the handler.

duplication.why: The 'daily + skipWeekend + non-working day => skip' decision exists in getNextDate and again, reshaped and weaker (weekends only), in getDatesInRange.

placement.why: Holiday and weekend logic sit in shared/schedules.ts, but the daily-skip rule lives inside getNextDate's loop and in the server handler rather than in the shared weekend-rule helper.

scope.why: All edits serve the four steps; tests are long single-line expectations but otherwise focused.

maintainability.why: Holidays reach only getNextDate: getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange and schedule-template call getDateWithWeekendRule without them, and daily skipping is decided in two diverging places, so behaviour differs by path.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange decides daily weekend skipping with its own d.isWeekend check instead of the shared isNonWorkingDay/daily rule used by getNextDate, and omits holidays when calling getDateWithWeekendRule.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange's inline `config.frequency === 'daily' && config.skipWeekend && d.isWeekend(date)` is a reshaped copy of getNextDate's daily-skip condition, minus holidays.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithWeekendRule gains a holidays parameter that only getNextDate passes; getDatesInRange re-implements the daily-skip rule inline; getUpcomingDates and schedule-template call the helper without holidays.
